title: The Treasure Hunt
subtitle: Murdoku Contest #1

clues.text: One occupant in each row and column. This time, there is no murderer.
clues.textZh: 每行、每列各占一格。本题没有凶手。

clues.text: Sloops, Frigates and the Galleon all count as ships, and they count as their own areas.
clues.textZh: 单桅帆船、护卫舰和大帆船都算船只，每一艘都是独立区域。

clues.text: He was beside a fire.
clues.textZh: 他在火堆旁边。

clues.text: He was on a hammock. There was no sack anywhere in his column.
clues.textZh: 他在吊床上。他所在列的任何位置都没有袋子。

clues.text: Someone exactly eight rows north of him was beside the tombstone.
clues.textZh: 有个人在他正好北面八行的位置，并且在墓碑旁边。

clues.text: He was east of Griselda and west of Linus.
clues.textZh: 他在 Griselda 的东边、Linus 的西边。

clues.text: She was beside a shelf.
clues.textZh: 她在书架旁边。

clues.text: She was beside some flowers.
clues.textZh: 她在花丛旁边。

clues.text: She was in the top row of her area.
clues.textZh: 她在自己所在区域的最上面一行。

clues.text: She was on the Cliff. No one in an adjacent column wore a hat.
clues.textZh: 她在悬崖区域。与她相邻列中的人都没有戴帽子。

clues.text: She was sitting in a chair. She was in a Cabin with someone wearing an eyepatch.
clues.textZh: 她坐在椅子上。她在一间小屋内，同屋还有一位戴眼罩的人。

clues.text: He was beside a barrel.
clues.textZh: 他在木桶旁边。

clues.text: She was on a Sloop.
clues.textZh: 她在一艘单桅帆船上。

clues.text: He was beside a tree.
clues.textZh: 他在树旁边。

clues.text: He was on a ship, beside some rope.
clues.textZh: 他在船上，并在绳索旁边。

clues.text: He was in the Water, beside a ship.
clues.textZh: 他在水域，并在船旁边。

clues.text: He was on a ship.
clues.textZh: 他在船上。

clues.text: He was on a bed.
clues.textZh: 他在床上。

clues.text: He was in the Water, beside a shark.
clues.textZh: 他在水域，并在鲨鱼旁边。

clues.text: She was sitting in a chair.
clues.textZh: 她坐在椅子上。

clues.text: She was at least six rows north of Linus.
clues.textZh: 她至少在 Linus 北面六行的位置。

clues.text: She was in front of a door.
clues.textZh: 她在门前的格子里（门内、门外的两个格子都算）。

clues.text: He was beside a pig.
clues.textZh: 他在猪旁边。

clues.text: He was in the Woods. He was not beside a tree.
clues.textZh: 他在树林里。他不在树旁边。

clues.text: She was beside a shrub.
clues.textZh: 她在灌木旁边。

clues.text: In the last square. It can be buried beneath an object that cannot otherwise be occupied.
clues.textZh: 宝藏在最后剩下的格子里。它可以埋在普通人物不能占据的物品下面。

source: Official contest PDF supplied by the user: murdoku-contest1-treasurehunt-EN.pdf. Puzzle by Manuel Garand. Art by Valentyna Bezdushna and Manuel Garand.
